sections.description_of_ingredients:
Abhrak Bhasma (Calcined mica) – This ash is used in Ayurveda for various disorders such as abdominal, liver, respiratory disorders. It has anti-inflammatory action and has digestive properties. 
 Shuddha Gandhak – This is a non-metallic solid element. In Ayurveda it is first detoxified to get shuddha Gandhak. Pure form of sulphur is used as Rasayan (Rejuvenate). It helps in improving digestion. 
 Loha bhasma – Iron ash is very useful in Anemic conditions. It is also effective in skin disorders, tuberculosis and pacifies all three doshas. It increases the RBCs count in the body. 
 Shuddha Parada – This is a pure form of mercury. It is used as medicine in lots of diseases because it also acts as Rasayan (Rejuvenating). Parada is silver colored liquid metal also called Quicksilver. It balances all the three doshas (Vata, Pitta and Kapha). It is Balya (Tonic). It improves digestion and strength. 
 Shuddha Vatsanabha ( Aconitum ferox ) – This herb balances all the three dosha and is very useful in patients suffering from piles. It also enhances the digestive fire due to its deepana and pachana properties. It is used as medicine after detoxifying. It has antipyretic and analgesic properties. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Make a kajjali from Parada and Gandhak in a khral yantra. 
 Now mix the rest of the ingredients in this kajjali and give Guduchi ( Tinospora cordifolia ) swaras bhavna. 
 Make 125 mg tablets and let them dry. 
 Kept these tablets in airtight glass container. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Amritankur loha is an Ayurvedic formulation. The ingredients in this formulation are helpful in blood disorders. They purify blood and nourish tissues of the body. They all improve digestion by improving digestive power.
sections.dosage:
1 tablet twice a day with the extracts or decoction of Amla ( Emblica officinalis ). 
 Caution 

 Avoid in pregnancy and in children. 
 Take under the medical supervision. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Amritankur Vati 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Kshudrarogadhikar 948/161-163 
 Introduction 
 Amritankur vati is an Ayurvedic formulation. It is a herbo-mineral composition effective in various disorders. The ingredients in this formulation are useful in nourishing bodily tissues. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Abhrak Bhasma 
 Shuddha Gandhak 
 Loha Bhasma 
 Shuddha Parada 
 Shuddha Vatsanabha 
 Shuddha Shilajit 
 
 Description of Ingredients 
 
 Abhrak Bhasma (Calcined mica) – This ash is used in Ayurveda for various disorders such as abdominal, liver, respiratory disorders. It has anti-inflammatory action and has digestive properties. 
 Shuddha Gandhak – This is a non-metallic solid element. In Ayurveda it is first detoxified to get shuddha Gandhak. Pure form of sulphur is used as Rasayan (Rejuvenate). It helps in improving digestion. 
 Loha bhasma – Iron ash is very useful in Anemic conditions. It is also effective in skin disorders, tuberculosis and pacifies all three doshas. It increases the RBCs count in the body. 
 Shuddha Parada – This is a pure form of mercury. It is used as medicine in lots of diseases because it also acts as Rasayan (Rejuvenating). Parada is silver colored liquid metal also called Quicksilver. It balances all the three doshas (Vata, Pitta and Kapha). It is Balya (Tonic). It improves digestion and strength. 
 Shuddha Vatsanabha ( Aconitum ferox ) – This herb balances all the three dosha and is very useful in patients suffering from piles. It also enhances the digestive fire due to its deepana and pachana properties. It is used as medicine after detoxifying. It has antipyretic and analgesic properties. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Make a kajjali from Parada and Gandhak in a khral yantra. 
 Now mix the rest of the ingredients in this kajjali and give Guduchi ( Tinospora cordifolia ) swaras bhavna. 
 Make 125 mg tablets and let them dry. 
 Kept these tablets in airtight glass container. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Amritankur loha is an Ayurvedic formulation. The ingredients in this formulation are helpful in blood disorders. They purify blood and nourish tissues of the body. They all improve digestion by improving digestive power. 
 Indications 
 
 Indigestion 
 Skin disorders 
 Effective in blood disorders 
 Diabetes 
 
 Dosage 
 1 tablet twice a day with the extracts or decoction of Amla ( Emblica officinalis ). 
 Caution 
 
 Avoid in pregnancy and in children. 
 Take under the medical supervision. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
